Container.Name: AI-Chief-of-Staff
Container.Overview:
AI Chief of Staff is a private executive operations workspace for meeting transcripts, action items, briefs, Microsoft 365 intake, planner connectivity, and administrative history management.
Security requirement: set AICOS_AUTH_TOKEN or API_TOKEN before exposing the app or using destructive admin tools. Admin history wipe is disabled until a token is configured.
Core features: - Meeting transcript processing and task extraction - Executive briefs, productivity insights, and follow-up tracking - Microsoft 365 and Google Calendar connectivity - Jira or Microsoft Planner connectivity status - Admin history wipe for starting fresh without losing system settings - Mobile-responsive PWA with push notifications - PostgreSQL or SQLite storage
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL database recommended. SQLite is supported for smaller single-user deployments.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface and API port.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent config, logs, and SQLite database when SQLite is used.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Uploaded transcript and recording files.

Config.Name: API Auth Token
Config.Description: Preferred backend API token. Destructive admin tools, including Wipe History, require AICOS_AUTH_TOKEN or API_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Legacy API Token Alias
Config.Description: Optional backward-compatible token alias. Prefer AICOS_AUTH_TOKEN for new installs.

Config.Name: OAuth State Secret
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign OAuth state values.

Config.Name: Frontend URL
Config.Description: Public browser URL for the app. Use your HTTPS URL when behind SWAG or another reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API. Add your HTTPS reverse-proxy URL in production.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when the app is behind SWAG or another trusted reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Database Type
Config.Description: Database type: postgres recommended, sqlite supported. First-run config is generated from these env values.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname or IP address. Leave blank only when DB_TYPE is sqlite.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL username.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional fallback Anthropic API key. Preferred location is Settings inside the app.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional fallback OpenAI API key. Preferred location is Settings inside the app.

Config.Name: Google Redirect URI
Config.Description: Google OAuth redirect URI, for example https://aicos.yourdomain.com/api/calendar/google/callback.

Config.Name: Microsoft Client ID
Config.Description: Microsoft Entra application client ID for Microsoft 365 intake, calendar, email, and Planner.

Config.Name: Microsoft Client Secret
Config.Description: Microsoft Entra client secret value.

Config.Name: Microsoft Tenant ID
Config.Description: Microsoft Entra directory tenant ID. Use the tenant GUID for app-only access.

Config.Name: Microsoft Redirect URI
Config.Description: Microsoft OAuth redirect URI, for example https://aicos.yourdomain.com/api/calendar/microsoft/callback.

Config.Name: VAPID Public Key
Config.Description: VAPID public key for push notifications.

Config.Name: VAPID Private Key
Config.Description: VAPID private key for push notifications.

Config.Name: VAPID Subject
Config.Description: VAPID subject email address.

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Node.js environment.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

Config.Name: Allow Insecure TLS
Config.Description: Allow self-signed certificates for internal integrations. Set false when all upstream services use trusted certificates.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions.
